primer: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Ltd (NSE: SEDEMAC) builds patented sensorless ISG, EFI ECUs, EV motor controllers, and genset AMF controllers (~75% India share). Business quality passes our blind audit (COMPOUNDER_PASS; 34.5% 5Y sales CAGR; 35.3% ROCE). Yet new capital is REJECTED at ₹3,129.10 (107.0x TTM P/E) given ₹3,050 fair value, -₹47 Cr FY26 FCF, ₹352 Cr debt, and 75–81% TVS reliance. For our 200-share Zerodha stake (14.56% weight), we recommend TRIM_OVERWEIGHT: sell 100 shares to cut weight to ~7.28% and hold 100 shares behind a ₹2,696.82 stop.
